title: Retired-key and SCHC generation metadata grow without bound
description: Security review: repeated rotations permanently accumulate LinkLayer retired keys and SCHC generation entries. Naive eviction would reopen old-key acceptance, but unbounded state enables memory exhaustion. Implement bounded durable key lineage tied to the bounded peer registry or compact per-slot generations, enforce rotation quotas, and stress-test bounded memory while all retired traffic remains rejected.
